entities.name: Kher Range
entities.description: Hidden part of the Koskun Mountains on Ulgrotha where the Anaba minotaurs live.

entities.name: Anaba minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs living a simple life in the Kher Range.

entities.name: Feroz
entities.description: Planeswalker who first arrived in the Homelands here, duelled Taysir, married Serra and was buried near here.

entities.name: Sandruu
entities.description: Latent planeswalker whom Feroz met in the Kher Range.

entities.name: Taysir
entities.description: Fought a duel with Feroz in the Kher Range.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: Married Feroz in a minotaur ceremony and buried him, erecting the Monument to Feroz.

entities.name: Ulgrotha
entities.description: Plane where the Kher Range lies.

entities.name: Eron
entities.description: Ruler whose search parties approach the Anaba home.

entities.name: Monument to Feroz
entities.description: Stone wall etched with the story of the world, erected by Serra.

events.summary: Feroz first arrives in the Homelands and meets the latent planeswalker Sandruu.
events.quote: It was here that Feroz first arrived in the Homelands, meeting the latent planeswalker Sandruu .

events.summary: Feroz and Taysir duel, and the Anaba pictograph history is destroyed.
events.quote: It was also here that the duel between Feroz and Taysir took place

events.summary: Feroz and Serra are married in a minotaur ceremony.
events.quote: Feroz and Serra were married in a minotaur ceremony.

events.summary: After Feroz's death Serra buries him and erects the Monument to Feroz.
events.quote: After his death, Serra buried Feroz in a marked grave near the spot where he had first come to Ulgrotha .

relations.quote: Feroz and Serra were married in a minotaur ceremony.
The Kher Range is a hidden part of the Koskun Mountains
